description: This file defines a Rust module for handling HTTP fetch requests, including data structures, default headers, deserialization logic, and conversion methods.

classes.name: HttpFetchRequest
classes.description: A data structure representing an HTTP fetch request with fields for URL, method, headers, credentials, body, timeout, and response encoding.

methods.name: borrow_from_str
methods.description: Creates an HttpFetchRequest from a string, interpreting it as a URL or JSON request.

methods.name: into_owned
methods.description: Converts an HttpFetchRequest with borrowed data into an owned version with static lifetime.
